title: Onward Band personnel: Perez, Gaspar, Johnson, Alexander, Matthews
summary: The interviewer reads off a photo's lineup and Barbarin confirms who played, including Vic Gaspar, Buddy Johnson's brother and Adolph Alexander.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh, let's see. Let me ask you. Okay. About the Onward Band. I saw a picture of the Onward Band.
How was it in there?

Oh, yeah. Let's see. They had, if I can remember, Manuel Perez, Peter Boccage, Andrew Kimball, Vic Gasper, Buddy or Yank Johnson? I can't remember. Was it Buddy or Yank played with it? Buddy. Buddy or Yank Johnson?
Was it Buddy Johnson played with you?
Buddy Johnson. Buddy. Did you have another trombone? No. Two trombones? Two trombones?
Who else? Who was the other trombone?
Buddy Johnson's brother. He was playing.
Oh, both of them. Yank. Yank. Yank was his name. Let's see. And, forget who. Vic Gasper. Buddy Adolph Alexander.
Vic Gasper. He was playing baritone and slide. He's dead. Yes.
Buddy Adolph Alexander. Did he play?
Adolph Alexander. He played with you?
He played, yeah. He played with you lately. Mm-hmm. He died, uh, about a year, two years.
Oh, no. He died longer than that.

Well, I'm working on this one particular band. He's dead longer than that. I'm going to get this straight. Huh? They had a, let's see. In the own what band, they had Matthews on drums. Hmm? Hmm? Matthews. That's it.
Yeah, Matthews on drums. Did Matthews ever play any drum in the Onward Band?
I don't know. Actually, Bebe Matthews. Bebe?
Bebe. You remember those Bebe used to play drum with y'all in the brass band? Bebe.
Yeah, I remember him. Hmm. And did Dandy Lewis play in that band? Hmm? Dandy Lewis. Oh, but sometime. Hmm-hmm. And what did he play? What instrument did he play? Huh? What instrument would he play?
He played a bass drum.
Hmm-hmm. The bass drum. And let's see, what am I leaving out now in that band? Oh, Eddie Jackson. Eddie Jackson. Did he play with that band?
Eddie Jackson was playing with the band I was with when he died. He died at the hospital.
He was in the Onward. Huh? He was in the Onward? In the Onward? O-B-B? He wasn't...
What band he played in, Eddie Jackson? Was he in the Onward brass band?
